from solution import divisor


def test_issue_example_15():
    """Example: divisor(15) == 4."""
    # divisors of 15 are 1,3,5,15 => count 4
    assert divisor(15) == 4


def test_issue_one():
    """Find the number of divisors of 1 is 1."""
    # divisors of 1 are 1 => count 1
    assert divisor(1) == 1


def test_issue_prime_7():
    """Find the number of divisors of a prime is 2."""
    # divisors of 7 are 1,7 => count 2
    assert divisor(7) == 2


def test_issue_small_composite_4():
    """Find the number of divisors of 4 is 3."""
    # divisors of 4 are 1,2,4 => count 3
    assert divisor(4) == 3


def test_issue_small_composite_6():
    """Find the number of divisors of 6 is 4."""
    # divisors of 6 are 1,2,3,6 => count 4
    assert divisor(6) == 4


def test_issue_composite_12():
    """Find the number of divisors of 12 is 6."""
    # divisors of 12 are 1,2,3,4,6,12 => count 6
    assert divisor(12) == 6


def test_issue_square_9():
    """Find the number of divisors of perfect square 9 is 3."""
    # divisors of 9 are 1,3,9 => count 3
    assert divisor(9) == 3


def test_issue_square_36():
    """Find the number of divisors of perfect square 36 is 9."""
    # divisors of 36 are 1,2,3,4,6,9,12,18,36 => count 9
    assert divisor(36) == 9


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """The number of divisors is an integer count."""
    # divisors of 15 are 1,3,5,15 => count 4 is an int
    assert isinstance(divisor(15), int)


def test_contract_single_argument_callable():
    """Public interface defines divisor(n) in solution."""
    # divisor takes one argument n, e.g. divisors of 6 are 1,2,3,6 => 4
    assert callable(divisor)
